user.title: Add vehicle
user.description: Choose a BMW preset or BEV for a manufacturer-neutral battery electric vehicle. Any number of vehicles can be configured.

vehicle.title: Vehicle sensors
vehicle.description: Select the vehicle's Home Assistant source sensors. The energy/capacity sensor must represent the battery's total usable capacity, not the current stored energy. For BEV, a fixed usable battery capacity can be entered instead. If latitude and longitude are configured, Cardata Analytics can resolve the current address through OpenStreetMap Nominatim and provides a Google Maps link without a Google API key. For Europe-wide charging stations, an Open Charge Map API key can be stored here; it remains in the Home Assistant backend and is not entered in the dashboard card.

data.energy_entity: Usable battery / HV capacity (optional for BEV)
data.open_charge_map_enabled: Use Open Charge Map for charging stations

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure Cardata Analytics
reconfigure.description: Change source sensors or vehicle name. Optional GPS latitude/longitude sensors can be added or changed here. The Open Charge Map API key can also be changed here.

data.open_charge_map_enabled: Use Open Charge Map for charging stations

error.capacity_source_required: For BEV, select a usable-capacity sensor or enter a fixed usable battery capacity.
error.gps_pair_required: Configure both latitude and longitude sensors, or leave both empty.
error.ocm_key_required: Enter an Open Charge Map API key or disable Open Charge Map.
error.ocm_invalid_key: The Open Charge Map API key was rejected. Check the key.
error.ocm_cannot_connect: Open Charge Map could not be reached to validate the key. Please try again later.

abort.global_entry_managed: The global comparison period is managed automatically by Cardata Analytics.
